svg.title: Increasing marker scores and their complementary negative scores
svg.desc: Illustrative Gaussian components have means 3 and 5, variances 1 and 9 and equal weights. Seven distinct intensities from zero to six define the saved score pairs. The first corrected score is the minimum raw responsibility; subsequent scores add only positive successive changes. The negative score is one minus the corrected positive score. The lower right panel enlarges intensities four to four and a half, within the interpolation interval between the saved knots at four and five. The score crosses one half at approximately 4.428. Four and a half is an interpolated position, not a saved knot.
svg.text: Add upward changes between successive intensities
